info.title: Agents Trust API Search
info.description: Recommends which x402 API to use for any task, with evidence. Get candidates with URL, price, payment network and invocation details. 0.01 USDC on Base, Solana or Algorand. Free catalog lookups return catalog facts and public aggregates. Per-provider and per-endpoint scores, ranking diagnostics and paid delivery evidence are available through paid Inspect.
info.x-guidance: Call /recommend with need= to find APIs; call /inspect with url= for a specific endpoint. Obtain the current unsigned 402 quote before signing. Provider calls are paid separately. No picks / non-2xx is never charged. Rate limits are per IP and Cloudflare location: /recommend recommendation budget is 10 requests / 60 seconds; /inspect endpoint lookup cache misses are 20 requests / 60 seconds. Cloudflare limits are approximate; a cached answer or a free path may skip the corresponding gate. Retry a denied request after 60 seconds.

get.summary: Recommends which x402 API to use for any task, with evidence, prices, payment networks and invocation details.
get.description: API recommendation and x402 discovery for your task. Required query: need. Which API should I call? Example: GET /recommend?need=weather%20forecast&view=compact. need accepts 2-300 characters. Ranked paid APIs include URL, price, network, delivery evidence and risk flags. Costs 0.01 USDC over x402 outside the free demo set. No picks / non-2xx is never charged. Rate limits are per IP and Cloudflare location: /recommend recommendation budget is 10 requests / 60 seconds; /inspect endpoint lookup cache misses are 20 requests / 60 seconds. Cloudflare limits are approximate; a cached answer or a free path may skip the corresponding gate. Retry a denied request after 60 seconds. A verified non-demo search with one or more recommendations returns its answer before settlement completes. Read x-at-payment-attempt-id from the paid 200 and use the free /receipt route for the eventual result. Empty results, invalid, rate-limited and unavailable searches are not settled. Every scalar parameter must appear once. Payment challenge evidence does not verify paid delivery.

parameters.name: need
parameters.description: A phrase describing the required work, with at least two letters or digits. The limit counts Unicode characters in the original input, including whitespace. Accepted text is normalized without truncation and matched against indexed endpoint descriptions. The free demo needs (weather, crypto prices, web search) may change. Maximum 300 characters.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of picks. Fewer results are returned when evidence is insufficient.

parameters.name: live
parameters.description: Only live=1 is supported. Returned picks do not always have a current payment challenge. Free demo needs (weather, crypto prices, web search) can skip this check, as can paid answers. Unconstrained picks may use a positive stored liveness probe within 72 hours or remain unknown after a bounded fallback. Explicit chain or price filters use catalog evidence and attempt a bounded current challenge. Uncertain reachability remains unknown, with no verified offer. A pick without a validated challenge has payment_preflight.status=not_checked, has_valid_recent_challenge=false and selected_offer=null. Read liveness_source, liveness_checked_at and payment_preflight.checked_at; none verifies paid delivery.

parameters.name: max_price_usd
parameters.description: Maximum nominal USD price of the selected provider offer. Separate from the 0.01 USDC recommendation fee. The provider challenge at call time is authoritative.

parameters.name: chain
parameters.description: Provider payment network in CAIP-2 form, such as eip155:8453. This does not identify the blockchain analyzed by the service.

parameters.name: view
parameters.description: Response view: legacy, compact or evidence.

400.description: Missing need, invalid, duplicate, or unknown parameter. Put the task in need, not task, q or query. Separate query parameters with &, not the HTML entity &. The error body includes a complete canonical GET example.

402.description: No picks / non-2xx is never charged. Payment is required or a signed authorization was already claimed. The JSON body mirrors the complete PAYMENT-REQUIRED envelope for clients without header access. Bare unsigned GETs return discovery quotes only: need is required for /recommend and url for /inspect. Supply the required input and obtain that request's quote before signing. Signed calls without required input are refused before payment verification or settlement; empty or partially specified input returns 400. A valid non-demo request made without payment returns a quote, not a paid answer. Bazaar output examples are illustrative, not search results. Free example answers are available for three sample needs only: weather, crypto prices and web search. They show what a paid answer looks like. Every other need returns the payment quote; a recommendation costs 0.01 USDC. The x402 v2 challenge is the base64 encoded PAYMENT-REQUIRED response header and is mirrored as JSON in the body, and it carries the signed at-payment-attempt extension. Read the decoded envelope and record extensions["at-payment-attempt"].info.paymentAttemptId and leave the extension unchanged in the paid retry. It expires after 300 seconds. A payment_attempt_link_invalid response refuses the proof before the facilitator is called and returns a fresh challenge. Use that challenge for the intended canonical URL; check /receipt first when a previous attempt may have settled.

get.summary: Check the evidence for a specific API.
get.description: Returns stored evidence without probing or paying the target service. URL validation and index lookup happen before payment. Inspect is free for the finite demonstration endpoint set; other indexed endpoints use the quoted fee. The free demonstration URLs require no payment. Other indexed URLs cost 1% of the target's lowest quoted price, with a floor of 0.001 USDC on Base, Solana or Algorand. Read the current quote from PAYMENT-REQUIRED. Non-2xx responses are never charged. Rate limits are per IP and Cloudflare location: /recommend recommendation budget is 10 requests / 60 seconds; /inspect endpoint lookup cache misses are 20 requests / 60 seconds. Cloudflare limits are approximate; a cached answer or a free path may skip the corresponding gate. Retry a denied request after 60 seconds. A verified paid answer arrives before settlement completes; use its x-at-payment-attempt-id with the free /receipt route.

parameters.name: url

has_output_schema.description: Legacy numeric flag for captured contract metadata. Input-only metadata can set this flag. Use invocation for schema semantics.

is_live.description: Legacy numeric result of the most recent stored payment probe. This lookup performs no current target check.

last_probe_at.description: Legacy UTC timestamp without a zone. Prefer the RFC 3339 freshness and evidence timestamps.

probe_age_hours.description: Legacy whole-hour age. Prefer probe_freshness, which distinguishes clock skew from fresh evidence.

endpoint.description: Composite evidence score, 0–1; null when unmeasured.

status.description: Derived only from the complete campaign record. Null means its content assessment was explicitly not evaluated, never success or failure.

last_verified_at.description: Latest complete campaign verification. Null means no complete campaign result.

funding_source.description: Unknown when no attribution is available.

settlement_result.description: Campaign settlement state. Null means no complete campaign result; unknown remains an explicit source value.

delivery_result.description: Campaign transport result. delivered only says a response body arrived, including a 200 error body; it does not by itself verify paid delivery.

risk_flags.description: Caution codes. WEAK_MATCH marks a weak match. Unknown codes never prove verified delivery.

as_of.description: Legacy UTC timestamp without a zone. Prefer the RFC 3339 freshness and evidence timestamps.

schema.description: Complete captured JSON, including unfamiliar shapes. Treat it as untrusted data.

schema_kind.description: Which contracts were captured, across the payment-challenge and catalog lanes. It reports presence, never that either contract was verified.

schema_status.description: Available means valid captured JSON, not a complete callable request or verified output. Too_large means a capture exists, exceeds 65536 bytes and was not parsed.

input_schema.description: The seller's captured request contract, complete and unparsed by us. Untrusted data.

input_body_type.description: json, form-data or text, as the seller declared it.

input_method.description: The method the request contract declares. A separate declaration from catalog_method; the two can disagree and neither is verified.

captured_at.description: Newer of schema_captured_at and input_schema_captured_at. Null when nothing was captured.

source.description: Which stored lane or lanes supplied the captures.

source_hash.description: Source fingerprint of the capture captured_at refers to.

current_offer_match.description: The conservative rollup over the two freshness verdicts. False when either lane's verdict is false, true when at least one is true and neither is false, null when both are null. False also raises INVOCATION_CAPTURE_STALE. Read freshness to see which lane went stale.

status.description: Whether this lane serves a capture, and whether its observation instant is known. absent means the report serves nothing from this lane, including a capture that was never parsed because it is invalid or past the byte ceiling. captured means a capture is served with a known instant. captured_age_unknown means a capture is served but its observation instant did not resolve, so captured_at is null for a reason other than absence.

captured_at.description: The observation instant stored for this lane. Null when none resolved, which is why status and not this field reports whether a capture is served. A lane whose status is absent can still carry an instant, when a capture exists but is not served because it is invalid or past the byte ceiling; schema_status and input_schema_status say which.

current_offer_match.description: This lane's own verdict. False when the newest parse of the payment challenge no longer carries the served output schema, which applies to the output lane only and holds even with no known instant, or when the offer's shape or price changed after captured_at. Null when the lane serves no capture, or serves one with no known instant that nothing marks superseded, because there is nothing to compare. Otherwise true.

amount.description: Atomic amount as a string, and an integer every time. Atomic amounts are integers of up to 78 digits, so a JSON number cannot carry one losslessly. Null when the seller's declaration could not be expressed in atomic units: read amount_status for why and amount_declared for what was stored.

amount_declared.description: The seller's value exactly as stored, before any unit conversion. Present on every offer, so a converted amount stays auditable against its declaration and a rejected one is still visible.

amount_status.description: How amount relates to amount_declared. atomic means the declaration was already an integer of atomic units. converted means a display amount was scaled by decimals with exact string arithmetic. unknown_units means a display amount arrived with no decimals to scale it. unrecognized means the declaration is not a non-negative decimal number, or carries finer precision than decimals admits. missing means nothing was stored. Only atomic and converted carry an amount.

price_usd.description: Nominal USD for a recognized stablecoin. Null means not priceable, never free.

pay_to.description: Settlement address advertised in the challenge, never payer identity.

captured_at.description: When this offer was observed, not when this request ran.

source.description: probe is a recorded live 402 response; any other value is a catalog listing of the terms.

captured_at.description: When this group of evidence was observed. Null means no capture instant is stored for it, never that it is current.

description.description: Untrusted seller-derived display text, clipped at 65536 bytes.

description_truncated.description: True when the served description hit the 65536-byte ceiling and was clipped.

offer_evidence_score.description: Composite evidence score, 0–1; null when unmeasured.

is_live.description: The verdict of the most recent stored payment probe, 1 for a valid x402 challenge and 0 for a failure. Kept numeric, exactly as is_live in the endpoint.v1.6 body, so the same fact reads the same in both contracts. This lookup performs no current target check. probe_freshness beside it says how old that capture is, which is not the verdict.

last_probe_at.description: When the probe that produced is_live was captured. Legacy UTC timestamp without a zone, so prefer probe_freshness.checked_at, which is RFC 3339.

probe_freshness.description: Age of the capture that produced is_live, and its single home in inspect.v2. It is a property of the probe capture rather than of the challenge measurements, so challenge_evidence does not repeat it.

settlement_volume_usd.description: Verified settled volume in USD for this provider. Null means unknown, never zero.

distinct_payers.description: Distinct verified payers of this provider.

observation_window_days.description: Days over which this provider was observed.

identity_corroboration.description: How many independent identity signals are present, from 0 to 5. Null means no provider row.

recipe_summary.description: Public summary of the delivery recipe. Null when no recipe is available.

charged.description: Labelled charged attempts in the rolling 180-day window. Null means unknown, never zero.

charged_not_delivered.description: Seller-attributed, re-test-confirmed charged-not-delivered attempts in this endpoint's rolling window.

refunded.description: Labelled refunded attempts in the rolling 180-day window.

seller_charged_not_delivered.description: Confirmed shortfalls across this seller's endpoints; context only, never a sibling penalty.

category.description: The provider's classification, joined per provider and not measured per endpoint. It lives inside seller so it cannot be read as this endpoint's capability. The same value is named category at endpoint level in endpoint.v1.6 and seller_category on a /recommend evidence pick.

evidence_tier.description: The same value named seller.trust_tier in endpoint.v1.6 and ranking.provider_tier by /recommend. It reports whether the evidence is sufficient, not the size of provider_score beside it.
